title: Detective: City of Angels
subtitle: 1940s Noir Mystery & LAPD Homicide Campaign
tagline: Step into the smoky, corrupt streets of 1940s Los Angeles and crack 9 gripping homicide cases.
loreSummary: Welcome to Los Angeles in the late 1940s—a glittering city of cinema glamour, back-alley murder, and ruthless corruption. As LAPD homicide detectives, interrogate deceitful suspects, gather forensic evidence, bribe informants, and outwit 'The Chisel' to solve complex cases and close the casebook.
keyFeatures: Groundbreaking 'ARC System' (Adaptive Response Card) providing responsive suspect interrogations
Playable cooperatively, solo (Sleuth mode), or competitively with one player acting as 'The Chisel'
9 intricately plotted cases written by mystery novelist Evan Derrick with atmospheric crime art
Rich period atmosphere: search crime scenes, call in snitches, and bluff suspects into confessions

city_of_angels_complete_dossier.name: The Full LAPD Casebook (All 9 Core Cases)
city_of_angels_complete_dossier.description: The complete narrative journey investigating all 9 intricate homicide cases across the seediest corners of Los Angeles.

city_of_angels_rookie_investigator.name: Sunset Boulevard Starter Trilogy (Cases 1–3)
city_of_angels_rookie_investigator.description: An introductory 3-case investigation arc getting your badge dirty in the early Hollywood and motel homicides.

city_of_angels_master_chisel.name: Homicide Division Master Detective (9 Cases & Smoke & Mirrors)
city_of_angels_master_chisel.description: An exhaustive investigative dossier covering all 9 base cases plus expansion mysteries at maximum difficulty.

milestones.title: The Big Squeeze
milestones.description: Interrogating suspects across Hollywood motels, bribing snitches, and solving your first high-profile homicide.

milestones.title: Deadly Reputation
milestones.description: Peeling back the glamorous facade of studio moguls and starlets to expose blackmail rings and mob ties.

milestones.title: Blood on the Boulevard
milestones.description: Confronting crooked cops and syndicate bookies across smoke-filled jazz clubs and underground casinos.

milestones.title: A Bullet for the District Attorney
milestones.description: Untangling high-level municipal corruption where municipal judges and syndicate bosses share bank accounts.

milestones.title: City of Angels Final Ledger
milestones.description: Delivering the final arrest warrants to the Chief of Police and cementing your reputation in LAPD legend.
